structured.answer: Yeah, I'd look into it more. It's the S&P 500 fund everyone talks about, the fee says "0.07% p.a." which sounds tiny, and it's NVIDIA, Apple, Microsoft inside, "+73%" over 5 years. stuck.why: Hit 'Save' and it threw me down to the bottom of the page to the FAQ, with the popup still open. Had to hit the X and then tap 'Overview' to get back up.
'This financial instrument may not be eligible for acquisition in your country of residence' – so can I buy it or not? Nothing told me what to do about it.
Volatility, Return per risk, Maximum drawdown – too many numbers I don't get, plus a paragraph of text. That's where I quit.

findings.what: Warning says it may not be eligible in my country but doesn't say what to do or what I could buy instead – that made me nervous
Hitting 'Save' on the settings popup jumped to the bottom of the page and the popup stayed open
Big red -4.82% daily change is the first number you see and it's scary
Lots of jargon with no plain explanation (Accumulating, drawdown, return per risk, UCITS)
Two different '1 year' numbers (+13.79% on the chart, +17.05% in the table) – confusing
Nothing about small monthly amounts or how fees hit them
Everything in EUR/USD and the tax info is for Germany – feels like it's not for me
Heat map and long tables are way too much on a phone
